Provider: Banca Raiffeisen di Mendrisio

Submission deadline: 30 June 2026

Number of scholarships: 1

Raiffeisen Bank, Mendrisio branch, offers a scholarship intended for a female or male student enrolled in the Master’s programme at the Academy of Architecture.

The scholarship is primarily aimed at Swiss citizens, preferably from Ticino, who are experiencing financial difficulties and therefore require financial support to continue their studies.

• Master in Architecture
  • Master in Storia e teoria dell’arte e dell’architettura 120
  • Master in Storia e teoria dell’arte e dell’architettura 90
